fee_notes: Base fee $85,000; 10% veteran discount available ($76,500). Payable at signing of Letter Agreement or Franchise Agreement. $20,000 earned and non-refundable upon signing; remaining $65,000 non-refundable when franchisor executes land acquisition contract. Conditional refund (minus $20,000) available if franchisor fails to identify and commit to land within 12 months.
raw_excerpt: You must pay CBAC an initial franchise fee of $85,000 (the "Franchise Fee"), payable in a lump sum at the earlier of your signing the Franchise Agreement or your signing the Receipt and Acknowledgement Letter Agreement... $20,000 of the Franchise Fee will be fully earned when paid and non-refundable... The remaining $65,000 will be non-refundable on the date CBAC executes a Contract for the acquisition of Land... If you are a current or former member of the United States Armed Forces and have been or will be honorably discharged then CBAC offers you a discount of 10% of the Franchise Fee.
